prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Personality Traits Selector: Redesign the pet choice screen into a split view with dynamic trait selection cards and active pet animation previews. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 70.7% with a high mean time of 1017s; structured trait picks make pet selection fast and engaging.)
1: [home, new_flow] Live Desktop Environment Calibration Flow: Introduce a desktop environment calibration step right after pet generation to verify desktop bounds and screen rendering. (why: Home step mean time is 2336s and 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show on desktop screens.)
2: [finish, reorder] Onboarding Celebration & Desktop Launch Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop launch ceremony screen immediately before completing onboarding. (why: Finish step drops to 68.7% conversion with mean duration of 5815s; a explicit launch milestone prompts final completion.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path Decision Quick Summary Callout: Update the choose_path text to explicitly call out estimated times for express adoption versus custom creation. (why: choose_path has a median duration of 8s but a mean of 514s, indicating decision hesitation for long-tail users.)
4: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Photo Styling Diagnostic Guidelines: Add photo lighting and angle guidance badges directly on the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or generating incorrect models.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Tray Icon Visibility Alert: Show an image hint during the waiting stage pointing to the system tray controls location. (why: 3 support emails reported user confusion on how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Compact Choice Split View Layout: Change choose_path screen layout to split view to present path choices side-by-side cleanly. (why: Mean time on choose_path is high (514s); side-by-side presentation streamlines path selection.)
